sources.title: saggamer/orchestrator-v1.5-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This text-model export contains the backbone and all five trained channels from Orchestrator v1.5: control, browser, MCP, coding and presentation. It preserves the original F32 low-rank expert weights and routers, with 16 experts in each of decoder layers 39–41 and two selected per token.

sources.title: saggamer/orchestrator-v1.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Orchestrator v1.5 is Kira Superapp's local, Apple Silicon research-preview model bundle for everyday assistance, browser work, and multi-step agentic tasks. It combines a Gemma 4 E4B instruction base with task-routed MLX adapters and Kira's bounded execution controller. Kira handles tool execution and returns observations to the model before it continues.
